engineMapping.method: research/editorial-titles-et7a/probes/mapping.ts rendered over reel B; frames inspected by the agent. Its sample copy was later changed to original words and the probe re-rendered on Node 22.23.1 with the same results.
engineMapping.staticOutline: Works without a style field: a stroke/strokeWidth text animator held at its end state (from == to) draws a static outline behind the fill (strokeWidth ≈ 2× the visible outline). Confirmed first, as G1 asked.
engineMapping.mixedFontsViaSpans: Works: spans with named styles and colours mix fonts within one layer. A span style inherits the base style's axes (needs axes: {} for a font without that axis).
engineMapping.dropShadow: Works (light.drop-shadow); blur 0 gives a hard sticker shadow.
engineMapping.glow: light.glow brightens the layer's own pixels and has no colour; a coloured halo is a zero-offset drop shadow.
engineMapping.textBoxes: `textBox` is wrapping only. Boxes behind text are `highlight` decorations (`box` is a stroked outline). Highlights centre on baseline − x-height/2 + offset, default thickness 1.25 × cap height, no horizontal padding.
engineMapping.wordReveals: Works: word, glyph and line text animators; Thai clusters stayed intact under glyph builds.
engineMapping.hollowCaps: Works: transparent fill with an outline animator.

loop.perCandidate: comp validate --font-coverage strict; comp render --font-coverage strict; comp lint --pixels true --legibility true --font-coverage strict; entrance/hold/exit sheets at native size and 360×640, from the build/hold/exit markers
loop.visualPass: --lint false while iterating on looks; lint once a candidate looked right; Node 22 verification run for all
loop.measurementWorkaround: With no measure command, the agent read cap height, x-height and advance widths from the font files with fontTools to stack lines and estimate widths before rendering.

legibility.policy: --legibility true defaults (heading 3:1, label 4.5:1, 6 px x-height at 360 px). Waivers saved per composition in metadata.readingPolicy (grammar.ts displayWaivers), text-contrast only, treated display layers only; labels never waived.
legibility.outlineFinding: The contrast mask strips animator stroke colour, so the held outline is drawn in the word's code colour and its ring counts as glyph pixels; the measure compares outline and fill with the footage behind. A dark outline over dark clothing reads about 1:1 while the fill reads clearly against its outline. Shadows and halos are not credited (as ET3 documents).
legibility.xHeight: All measured layers ≥ 6.3 px at 360 px (smallest: 24 px Archivo labels, 6.31).
legibility.hollowCaps: a06 SUNDAY (transparent fill) is unmeasured: no glyph-interior pixels.

gaps.cost: 5 of 11 fix iterations (4 widths, 1 decoration offset) and font metrics read outside the engine for every stacked lockup
gaps.recommendation: Do next. Expose line, ink and cap boxes and decoration geometry so a planner can stack and fit lines before rendering.

gaps.gap: ET6b widened: contrast for treated display text
gaps.cost: All 16 candidates needed waivers; the two weak-script cases (b04, a06) were caught by eye, not lint
gaps.recommendation: Measure fill against its own outline/shadow/halo ring and the ring against the footage, and set the G1 display level; keep 4.5:1 for labels (lint caught b06's label correctly).
